purpose: Track Cirsium head-level attraction versus accessibility versus reproductive service or damage, per standardized video bout; companion to EAzami Aim2 ledgers, NOT a replacement.
authority: No field intervention authorization; observation-only specification pending local consent/site/rights checks.

source_ledgers.denominator: equal verified observation minutes and detection/camera-effort coverage

source_ledgers.outcome: final filled/viable achenes linked to the same head

source_ledgers.context: whole-plant reproductive display, never use as head-level replicate

unit: One clearly distinguishable organism approach episode at one head; if same insect reapproaches within one bout, treat as repeated bouts unless identity certain.

allowed.sex_age_and_taxonomy: Taxon identity can be unresolved. Behavioral role requires evidence, not insect order or GloBI interactionType.

rules: approached=1 on all valid episode rows; absence requires the video-effort ledger, never inferred from no rows.
Anther/stigma contact is reproductive-structure touch, not evidence of pollen deposition or viable seed set.
A positive pollen-deposition assay requires actual contact and a traceable independent assay.
Confirmed oviposition must cite egg scars or rearing or video-confirmed ovipositor insertion; mere landing is not enough.
An enemy with observed search but no host identity cannot be recorded as species-specific parasitoid success.
host_killed_before_seed_damage may only be 1 when linked_host_id, host_attacked_confirmed=1 and seed_damage_timing_assessed=1. Otherwise record NA (unknown), not 0.
seeds_saved_inferred is an interpretation and may never be 1 from event observation alone; requires independent matched viability/damage control and causal attribution.
Each episode has unique record_id and a stable head, bout, and clip; allow co-observed florivory without imposing insect-wide fixed guild value.
World-based route refers to measured gravity frame, not head-axis frame; when field video cannot disambiguate, label undetermined.
Camera detection effort must be blinded/standardized across treatments; event-triggered clips cannot estimate number of approaches without camera false-negative validation.
One row per approach episode is not an independent plant or head replication; randomization and analysis unit must remain plant or head under confirmed experimental design.

Flower-head reproductive sex matters: Cirsium arvense is imperfectly dioecious and male heads and female heads can have distinct shapes, pollen service and seed-production endpoints. Record observed head sex, or not_determined; do not pool male-head viable achene endpoints with female-heads.

Pre-entry guild is an independently identified candidate identity at the moment of approach; 'behavioral_role' describes subsequently observed actions. Do not assign 'seed_feeder_candidate' only after egg success, or assign 'legitimate_pollinator_candidate' only after anther/stigma contact.
pre_entry_guild != unresolved requires independent pre-entry evidence (taxon plus locally applicable biology or blinded pre-access ID). GloBI pollinates alone or insect order is not sufficient.

Compute guild-specific P(oviposition | approached) including independently assigned candidate seed-feeder approaches that FAILED to lay eggs, otherwise defense efficacy is biased upward by denominator selection.
Pre-entry assignments may be unresolved: count unresolved fraction and restrict comparison to taxa with validated guild criteria, never retrospectively drop failures from denominator.

eligible_estimands.interpretation: physical initial reach given observed approach
eligible_estimands.source: event table conditional on same verified effort

eligible_estimands.interpretation: selective bract/thorn/guild routing, not one pooled insect effect
physical floral service route, not confirmed seed set
early antagonist access only if adult oviposition stage sampled
attack conditional on observed searching, not prevented seed damage
outcome from head ledger; reconcile pollen, oviposition, early parasitoid and abiotic wetting separately
Requires independently assigned candidate guild and unsuccessful approaches in denominator; avoids conditioning on the post-approach successful 'ovipositing_seed_feeder' label
eligible_estimands.source: event table with paired effort denominators and pre-entry taxon evidence

missingness: No events or data gaps must be distinguished via linked observation_bout_id, duration, camera error, phenology and weather. A missing guild is not guild absence.
statistical_nulls: VISIBILITY_ONLY: pigment/UV affects arrivals but not entry|arrival when true outer architecture held fixed.
FILTER_ONLY: accessible armature/spines affect entry|arrival but not arrivals per exposure-minute.
FUNCTIONAL_COMPLEMENT: visual signalling plus barrier improves per-head effective pollination and viable achenes more than either alone.
FUNCTIONAL_SUBSTITUTION: independent outer geometries obstruct the same antagonist pathway to a similar degree, with negligible marginal benefit of adding the second.
ENEMY_SHIELDING: barrier suppresses early host-killing parasitoid attack more than initial egg establishment, increasing irreversible seed loss.
ABIOTIC_ALT: head orientation alters rain/UV/pollen viability without altering insect route-based access.

critical_prior_art.result: trade-off mitigation and floral filters known; requires new Cirsium-specific causal demonstration
C. discolor pollinators did not contact sticky traps, several seed predators evaded; obstacle presence does not imply realized tradeoff
C. purpuratum plant-level floral display increase, per-head visitation near constant; distinguish plant from head
C. purpuratum plant-level flower production can raise predispersal seed predation; not head thorn selection
Cirsium arvense staminate versus pistillate heads can have different shapes, flower physiology and viable-achene outcomes; focal head sex must be known before sex-specific fitness inference.

claim_ceiling: OBSERVATION_CONTRACT_NOT_DATASET: no guild effect, fitness interaction, correlated evolution or adaptation inferred.
